title: Verify node-down alert fired for the vanished pc01 worker (2026-10-12→14)
description: VM 100 (talos-pc01, sole Proxmox guest, no pinned workloads) was off 2 days. node-down.yaml should have paged on kube_node_status_condition Ready!=true.
